text: Consider the following recursive algorithm, which takes as input an array A and start and finish indices, s and f. What is the output when the algorithm is run on array A =1,2,...,12 with s =1 and f = 12. Next, derive a recurrence for the runtime of the algorithm 7'(n) and use the master method to determine the runtime in big-Theta notation. Practice(A,s,f) if s < £ q = round-down (2s+f)/3 for i = q+1 to £ print A[i] Practice(A,s,q) else print A[s]
